note: Attacker-controlled font file provides a LookupFormat2 with unitSize=4 in VarSizedBinSearchHeader, smaller than LookupSegmentSingle<HBUINT16>::static_size (6).
The binary search uses header.unitSize (4) as the element stride instead of the actual struct size (6).
Element pointer computed as mid * 4, which does not align with 6-byte struct boundaries, causing reads from wrong offsets.
Reads first and last from misaligned position; these bytes were never initialized as proper struct fields, causing use-of-uninitialized-value.
